{{16SEBracket}} == Use == : ''Template for a single-elimination bracket with 16 starting players'' * Five rounds, with 16, 8, 4 and 2 players respectively. * Variables are R1D1-16, R2W1-8, R3W1-4, R4W1-2 for the players, with the addition of "race" and "score" for the races and scores. *To add information about maps, link to vods, a short note, etc. use (See [[Template:BracketMatchSummary]] for further details): * '''Overtime:''' If a map went to overtime, add |map#ot=1. The value 1 equals the number of consecutive overtimes, rarely more than 1. * '''Walkover:''' If a player leaves WO, add |R#D#race=wo. Can also be set to red, green, blue, yellow and white - please avoid this if you can. * 3rd place match variables are R4D1 and R4D2. If the 3rd place match is not played, nothing needs to be filled in those fields and the 3rd place match will not appear on the page. *To '''bold''' winners and winners' scores use: |R1D1=Playername |R1D1score=2 '''|R1D1win=1''' *To '''customize the names of the Rounds''' (default: Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Finals) use: |R1= |R2= |R3= |R4= |L4= *To '''remove Round titles''' completely use: |hideroundtitles=true *To customize '''column width''' or '''score width''' use: |column-width= |score-width= == Copy/Paste ==
